notes.title: Achievements and Cloud Saves Are Here!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! ShockBot here to share with you that we are dropping a SHOCKing new update. No BOTs were harmed during the updating process. Now, wait a minute—why are we doing updates to BigBot? He is our enemy!

Here are the release notes for PowerBots Builders version 1.1.2, being released RIGHT NOW!

[list]
[*] Steam Achievements + Steam Cloud saves
[*] Changed map for BigBot boss fight
[*] Added armor + timed weak spot to BigBot for additional damage
[*] Added particles to BigBot's attacks to indicate the attack source
[*] Improved collision detection while dashing
[*] Dash attack collision fix now allows dashing mid-ramp
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.2 Out Now!
notes.content:
We’re thrilled to announce the release of PowerBots Builders Version 1.2! This update is packed with awesome new features and improvements that we know you’re going to love. Get ready to dive into:

[list]
[*] Interactive NPCs: Bring your worlds to life like never before! 
[*] File Saving: Now you can save your incredible creations and story progress and revisit them whenever you like! 
[*] Hidden Easter Eggs: What secrets will you uncover? 
[*] Improved Controller Support: Experience even smoother and more intuitive control. 
[*] Cleaner Level Select Screen: Navigating your adventures just got a whole lot easier. 
[*] Unlockable Levels and Power-ups: Prepare for new challenges and exciting rewards! 
[*] Brand New "Space Station Home Base" Level: Explore the cosmos and build among the stars!
[/list]

We've also fixed some bugs and glitches to ensure a smoother experience. Thank you to our amazing community for your continued support and feedback!

Update your game now! How will you design your Space Station? Share your creations with us!

notes.content: Would it really count as a big update if there wasn't an emergency hot-fix? ;)

notes.title: Atalo Field Update
notes.content:
[h2]Our most exciting update yet![/h2]
Jeremy here! I've been working hard to make this thing happen. Was really excited to get ready for the summer events and happy to get this in right on time. I hope you enjoy this update as much as I do! 

Here's a rundown of what we have ready for you:

[h2]Take on new challenging levels[/h2]
Fight BigBot, defeat a swarm of baddies, and unlock the new Ground Pound ability in the newest Atalo Field levels.

[h2]Collectathon galore![/h2]
New for Collectathon fans! Each level is now graded by PowerStone shards collected, enemies defeated, and a time ranking. Can you score 100 on each level?

[h2]Free Play Upgrades[/h2]
Fixed a few things with the saving and added furniture back in. Free Play in Story Mode is one of the features I was most excited about in early development. It got so complicated that I thought I had to take it out! Thankfully, I was able to add it back in for this update and it's running as smooth as butter.

[h2]Still much more in store :)[/h2]
There are even more Story Mode level updates and new Free Play features just around the corner so be sure to keep an eye out for more!

-Jeremy

notes.title: Small Update
notes.content: Small update to the space station in story mode to simplify unlockables for new players.

notes.title: New Party Modes, CatBot, and menu fixes
notes.content: Added new party modes - Asteroid Attack, Race to the Finish, Free Play, and Last Bot Standing. Also fixed an array of issues with the menu and settings and added a more interesting Free Play (temporary ending) for story mode. Now featuring CatBot as player 3 in Party Mode! CatBot was last year's Draw Your Own PowerBot contest winner from RetroGameCon 2022!
